purpose: Describe an action as scheduled or planned.
keywords: Dictionary-form verb + 予定だ; noun + の予定だ.
I am scheduled to go on a business trip next week.
The meeting is scheduled to start at three.
I am scheduled to be off tomorrow.
formation: Dictionary-form verb + 予定だ; noun + の予定だ.
restrictions: Often suggests an arrangement or schedule rather than only a personal wish.
mistake: Use a noun with の before 予定.
